title: ProcessBench: which step of a solution contains the first error?
decision: which step of a step-by-step solution to a mathematics problem contains the first error, or that the solution contains no error

source.name: ProcessBench (ProcessBench: Identifying Process Errors in Mathematical Reasoning, arXiv:2412.06559)
source.split: gsm8k (400 cases, 193 without error), math (1,000 cases, 406 without error), olympiadbench (1,000 cases, 339 without error), omnimath (1,000 cases, 241 without error)

notes: The number of options differs per row: one per step, keyed by the step index of the data (from 0, the keys of state.steps), plus `none`; `options` is the maximum (minimum 3, median 7; 4 rows have more than 26) and `chance` is the mean of 1 / options over the rows. Sampled per subset with random.Random(20261007) after sorting by id, keeping each subset's share of error-free solutions (label -1): gsm8k 250 rows with 121 `none`, math 250 rows with 102 `none`, olympiadbench 250 rows with 85 `none`, omnimath 250 rows with 60 `none`; gold `none` in 368 of 1000 rows, so always answering `none` scores 0.368. In 132 rows the final answer is correct although a step is wrong (meta.final_answer_correct). The solutions are model-written (meta.generator: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 88, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 150, Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct 53, Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct 39, Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct 34, Qwen2-72B-Instruct 91, Qwen2-7B-Instruct 120, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 43, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 74, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 108, Qwen2.5-Math-72B-Instruct 79, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 121); the error positions are human labels. The licence recorded here is that of the ProcessBench card; the licences of the problem sources named by the subsets were not checked. Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 34 of 1000 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 966 items remain. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 27 of 966 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 939 items remain.
